description: This file contains mock implementations for testing the Layer 2 (L2) components of the RDK framework. It defines a class L2TestMocks that initializes mock objects for various system components, manages their lifecycle, and provides methods to invoke service methods via JSON-RPC, primarily used in unit testing or integration testing scenarios within the RDK environment.

classes.name: L2TestMocks
classes.description: A mock class used for testing the L2 components, providing methods to invoke service methods and manage mock component lifecycles.

methods.name: InvokeServiceMethod

methods.description: Overloaded method to invoke a service method expecting a string result.
